description: Unsigned steps to take an open order on the X Layer voucher market (Seaport, chain 196). side buy: pay a listing (ask.hash from xl_market) in OKB. side sell: accept an offer on a voucher you hold (v = voucher id; hash optional, default = best open offer or collection offer). The seller pays the 0.75% OwlGate fee out of the price. Dry-run from `from`; the wallet signs and sends itself, OwlGate never holds funds.

hash.description: Order hash (ask.hash for buy; offer or collection offer hash for sell, optional)

name: xl_fill
title: Fill an X Layer Voucher Order (unsigned)
